name: Gable
summary: A twelve-page mortgage CRM: leads, a loan pipeline board, loan files, documents and live rates
about: A navy and brass CRM for a mortgage loan officer, broker or lending team. Work leads into applications, drag loan files through the pipeline, clear conditions and collect documents, quote payments with a live calculator, lock rates from a live rate sheet, and keep tasks, a calendar and borrower chat in one place. Each loan file shows a house that builds itself stage by stage.
how: Use the grouped sidebar (collapse it with the arrow, or the menu button on a phone) to open any of the twelve pages.
On Pipeline, drag a loan card to the next stage, or focus it and press M; open a card to see its file.
In a loan file, tick conditions, upload or verify documents, lock the rate and press Move to watch the next part of the house build.
On Leads, add or edit a lead, then Start application to open a new loan file; Quote sends the numbers to the calculator.
On Calculator, slide price, loan, rate and term; the payment mix and the amortization chart update as you move.
Rates tick live in the top bar and on the Rates page; Tasks, Calendar and Messages (with replies) keep the day moving.
